```text
# #2798: Patch: card animations for Stinkyscape, part two: stinkyscape-091 to the end
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This part fills in the second half of Stinkyscape's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/stinkyscape-2.json5`, for #2782. The half runs from `stinkyscape-091` to the end of the set, and includes the set's tokens and the Starship pieces' other hooks.

- **The set.** Stinkyscape has 178 cards and 52 tokens. 80 are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps (17 of them Field Spells), and 71 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate. Part one, `001`–`090`, has its own sub-issue of #2782.
- **The table split.** #2784 may have merged one `stinkyscape.json5`. If so, split it into `stinkyscape-1.json5` (001–090) and `stinkyscape-2.json5` (091 to the end) in this part's first commit, with the loader and the totality test reading both. Whichever half starts first does the split.
- **Read first.** `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`, and the "A task over every card" section of `docs/issues-and-patches.md`. This is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps.** Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap in the range gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with a hook.** Every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook.
- **Field Spells.** Every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry.
- **Vanilla Units and tokens.** A vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`. A token gets an entry only where it earns one: Stinkyscape has 52, so list the ones given entries.
- **Picking.** Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788), never by comparing card texts, and give a reason for any override. Use Tech sub-looks (#2792), with `rocket` for the space cards. Scale by cost and rarity.
- **The Starship.** The Starship's own moments belong to the Starship sub-issue of #2782:
  - the fuse;
  - the launch;
  - Launch Sequencer `stinkyscape-t-ai-05`;
  - Jlockeed's Starship Retrofitting Program `stinkyscape-130`;
  - the Launchers `stinkyscape-140` to `-143`.
  
  Give these cards' other hooks entries here, and mark the launch hooks `"none: Starship part"`.
- **Bespoke.** 3 to 6 Flourishes built from motif primitives, each with a one-line reason.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances:** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note.
- **New motifs.** Add one by the doc's rule if 3 or more cards fit none. Name it in the doc's table first, so part one sees it.
- **Set pieces.** List any candidates in the PR.

### The deliverable

A table in the PR with one row per card in the range. Each row has:

- the id and name;
- each hook's motif, palette and scale, or its key or `none` reason;
- the census suggestion;
- why.

## Acceptance

- [ ] At least 55% of the range's non-token cards have an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A test enforces both on this file.
- [ ] Every Field Spell in the range has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] 3 to 6 bespoke Flourishes, each with a vitest and an R200 check.
- [ ] The PR's per-card table covers every card in the range and the tokens given entries.
- [ ] No hidden card keys an entry (R202).
- [ ] The `/dev/fx` gallery plays every entry.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] Web typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.
```
